title: Verify ordinary geometry and special pose indices
changes: Identify ordinary geometry groups and special-pose index cells while comparing the recorded home scene with managed sources altered.
validation: Windows GNU test build geometry-special-ordinary-build-8vye9kkd and Wine geometry-special-ordinary-wine-lby31j3d passed. E170-d169 compares 1800 recorded frames: full state, clock, central/wide video, OAM and five nonempty audio streams match each frame with 48 geometry and 3856 special index bytes altered in the managed machine.

The trace observed 28 typed geometry requests and 56 bytes in state-width and state-height groups, plus 12 typed requests and 48 bytes from 12 distinct null special index cells; zero trace requests were dropped. Protected inputs passed, scratch was removed and Wine server drained. A D-Bus assertion was logged but the test completed successfully.
limitations: Address attribution does not prove original reader instructions, producer identities or an uninterrupted pose animation. The checkpoint lineage is not independently reconstructed end-to-end; generated dispatch may fall back to interpretation. Other paths and domains, Linux, USA and native Windows remain open. No performance measurements.
